text:
Lina R: hey all, just started today. i'm blocked on Okta SSO: my Google Workspace account works, but when i try to sign in to 1Password via SSO it says 'SSO enrollment pending' and there's no invite. also Okta Verify won't let me add MFA, just times out. anyone know who to bug? :thinking:
Sam (IT): welcome Lina! quick check: did you get the 'Welcome to Redwood' email with the 1Password invite link? sometimes corporate invites go to spam.
Lina R: i looked, nothing in inbox or spam. checked company email (lina@example.com) and verified mailbox is active.
it-bot: Provisioning log: user lina@example.com provisioned to Google Workspace and Okta at 2101234550. 1Password seat request queued.
Sam (IT): ok the provisioning logs show 1Password seat queued but not assigned. i'll push the seat now manually. also, for Okta Verify timeout, try clearing app cache or reinstall. which platform are you on?
Lina R: macbook air m2. reinstalled Okta Verify twice, still times out when sending push.
Olivia (DevEx): hey Lina — if you need immediate access to repos, we can enable a temporary app-password for git over HTTPS and create a short-lived API token. also we'll add a step doc to the new-hires channel for these exact steps.
Sam (IT): pushed 1Password seat and forced reprovision. please log out of 1Password and sign in again with SSO. i also triggered a re-send of Okta Verify push.
Lina R: signed into 1Password successfully, seat is there. Okta Verify still timing out though.
Sam (IT): since 1Password is done, you should be unblocked for most stuff. for Okta Verify let's try this: 1) connect to home/phone hotspot (sometimes corp network blocks), 2) open Okta in an incognito window to avoid extensions, 3) hit 'Send Push' and check notifications. if it still fails, i'll remote into your machine.
Lina R: hotspot worked! Okta push arrived and i enrolled Device Trust. all good now. thanks everyone. :tada:
Sam (IT): great — marking provisioning ticket resolved. welcome aboard Lina! :wave:
